outcome: Efficacy in controlling placental bed bleed
cohort: The study included 100 patients diagnosed with Placenta Previa via USG, irrespective of their gestational age and parity.
finding: Conservative surgical techniques were effective in controlling placental bed bleeding in placenta previa, with Cho Square compression sutures being 100% effective in cases without adherence and significantly more successful than Stepwise Uterine Devascularisation (79.91% effective).
